lines.text: John sees a beast with ten horns and seven heads rise out of the sea, and the dragon gives it power.
The beast's mortal wound is healed, and the whole world follows it and worships the dragon and the beast.
The beast is given authority to act for 70 months, speaks blasphemies against God, and wages war against the saints.
A second beast rises out of the earth with two horns like a lamb, speaks like a dragon, and tells people to make a temple to the first beast.
The second beast requires everyone to receive a mark on the right hand or forehead, and the number of the beast is 666.
